# AI Employee — Statement of Work

**Between:** SMD Services, a division of SMDurgan, LLC ("SMD")
**And:** {{CUSTOMER_LEGAL_NAME}} ("Customer")
**Effective date:** {{EFFECTIVE_DATE}}
**Initial term:** Six (6) months from the Effective Date
**Monthly retainer:** $5,000 USD

---

## 1. The Service

SMD will deliver an AI Employee service to Customer. The AI Employee is a dedicated AI agent that learns Customer's business and acts on Customer's behalf within the scope and trust boundaries set out in Exhibit A.

The agent is named **{{AGENT_NAME}}** (Customer's choice during onboarding). It operates under Customer's direction, communicates via the channels Customer authorizes (email, Slack, etc.), and works within the connectors Customer authenticates.

## 2. What's Included

- One AI agent dedicated to Customer
- The marketing-agencies skill pack (Exhibit B) configured for Customer's specific tools and workflows
- Email identity for the agent at a subdomain SMD provisions
- Up to three connected channels (e.g., Gmail, Slack, plus one more)
- Connector access to Customer's tools (CRM, PM, time-tracking, paid-media platforms, etc.) through standard integrations
- Memory layer (the agent remembers Customer's clients, engagements, brand voice)
- Monitoring and watchdog with automatic recovery on common failures
- Customer success cadence — Day-7, Day-30, Day-60, and Day-90 check-in calls
- Live KPI dashboard accessible to Customer's named champion
- Incident response per Exhibit C
- Up to ten (10) hours per week of SMD support time

## 3. What's Not Included

- Additional AI agents beyond the one dedicated agent (each additional agent is a separate engagement)
- Skills outside the marketing-agencies pack (additional skills can be quoted as a scope expansion at $200/hr)
- Custom integrations with systems not supported by standard connectors (quoted separately if needed)
- Compliance certifications (SOC2, HIPAA, etc.) that require dedicated infrastructure
- 24/7 on-call coverage (SMD operates 8a–6p MST, Monday–Friday)
- Anything explicitly classified as "Refused" in Exhibit A

## 4. Onboarding

Onboarding consumes the first month of service and includes:

- **Day 1–5: Discovery and provisioning.** Kickoff call, tool stack audit, infrastructure setup, agent installation.
- **Day 6–14: Shadow mode.** The agent observes and drafts but does not send messages, modify records, or take any externally visible action. Customer reviews drafts daily.
- **Day 15: Graduated autonomy.** The agent begins acting per the Trust Ceiling Matrix in Exhibit A.

Onboarding requires Customer's active participation. Customer commitments are listed in Section 7.

## 5. Term and Termination

**Initial term:** Six (6) months, beginning on the Effective Date.

**90-day evaluation window:** During the first 90 days, Customer may terminate this agreement with thirty (30) days written notice. No penalty. The remaining unearned portion of any prepaid month is refunded.

**After Day 90 through end of initial term:** Either party may terminate for material breach with 30 days written notice and an opportunity to cure. Early termination by Customer (without breach by SMD) requires payment of the remaining balance of the initial term.

**End of initial term:** At end of Month 6, this agreement converts to month-to-month at the same retainer. Either party may terminate any month thereafter with 30 days written notice.

**Termination by SMD for cause:** SMD may terminate this agreement with 30 days written notice and refund any unearned portion of the current month if Customer requests the agent to perform actions that, in SMD's reasonable judgment, create material legal, reputational, or compliance exposure beyond the scope of this agreement.

## 6. Payment

- **Retainer:** $5,000 USD per month, billed in advance on the first business day of each service month.
- **First month:** Paid on Effective Date; covers onboarding.
- **Late payment:** Service may be suspended (not terminated) if payment is more than 14 days past due.
- **Support hour overage:** SMD support time exceeding the included 10 hours per week is billed at $200/hr, invoiced monthly. SMD will provide notice before incurring overage hours; Customer may decline.
- **Pass-through costs:** Infrastructure costs (Customer's agent compute, token usage, etc.) are absorbed by SMD within reasonable usage limits. Sustained usage exceeding $200/month in pass-through costs may trigger a usage conversation; SMD does not pass these through without prior notice.

## 7. Customer Responsibilities

Customer agrees to:

- Designate a **named champion** (single point of contact) and a named backup within Customer's organization.
- Provide timely access to the systems the agent will integrate with, including OAuth admin consent where required.
- Review the daily Drafts Digest during the shadow-mode period and provide feedback within reasonable timeframes.
- Notify SMD promptly of any agent behavior that appears incorrect, off-brand, or beyond the agreed scope.
- Comply with applicable laws (TCPA, CAN-SPAM, fair-housing where relevant, data-privacy regulations) when directing the agent's actions.
- Not request the agent to perform actions classified as "Refused" in Exhibit A.

## 8. Confidentiality

Each party will protect the other party's confidential information with the same care it uses for its own (and no less than reasonable care). Confidential information may be used only to perform under this agreement. The obligation survives termination for two (2) years.

## 9. Data

- Customer's data is Customer's. SMD acts as a service provider/processor.
- Customer retains all rights to its content, customer data, and outputs.
- SMD may use aggregate, anonymized operational data (token spend, error rates, support patterns) to improve the service.
- On termination, SMD will export Customer's vault (the agent's memory of Customer's business) within 14 days and provide it to Customer. SMD will then delete or archive Customer's data per Section 11.

## 10. Service Levels

See Exhibit C. Severity classifications, acknowledgment targets, and remediation targets are binding commitments. SMD does not offer financial credits for SLA misses in this Phase 1 agreement; remedies are limited to reasonable good-faith remediation, written incident reports, and voluntary partial refunds at SMD's discretion for material reputational harm.

## 11. Data Retention

- Active engagement: Customer's data lives in SMD's infrastructure for the duration of service.
- On termination: SMD exports Customer's vault within 14 days. SMD retains Customer-identifiable data for 30 additional days in case of re-engagement, then purges.
- SMD retains aggregate, anonymized operational data indefinitely for service improvement.

## 12. Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by law, neither party will be liable to the other for indirect, special, incidental, consequential, or punitive damages. Each party's total liability under this agreement is limited to the greater of (a) the fees Customer has paid in the six months preceding the claim, or (b) $30,000. This limitation does not apply to breaches of confidentiality, willful misconduct, or gross negligence.

## 13. Intellectual Property

- SMD retains rights to its underlying methodology, runbooks, skill libraries, and the AI Employee service.
- Customer retains rights to all of its content, business data, and outputs the agent produces on Customer's behalf.
- The agent's configuration for Customer (vault contents, brand-voice samples, skill tuning) is Customer's property; SMD provides export on termination.

## 14. Governing Law

This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Arizona, without regard to its conflict-of-laws provisions. Any dispute will be resolved in the state or federal courts located in Maricopa County, Arizona.

## 15. Entire Agreement

This SOW, together with its Exhibits, constitutes the entire agreement between the parties regarding its subject matter and supersedes any prior agreements or understandings. Changes must be in writing and signed by both parties.

# Exhibit A — Trust Ceiling Matrix

Each row classifies a task class the agent may encounter. Three classifications:

- **Autonomous** — agent acts directly, logs the action, Customer is notified via audit log.
- **Draft for review** — agent prepares the action and submits to Customer's review queue. Customer approves or modifies before action takes effect.
- **Refused** — agent does not perform this action class. If asked, the agent declines and explains why.

Pre-filled with SMD defaults. Customer overrides during onboarding kickoff. Reviewed at Day-13 trust-ceiling walkthrough and any time during the engagement on Customer's request.

| Task class                               | Default classification         | Customer override | Escalation rule                                                               |
| ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ----------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Inbox triage (read, categorize, label)   | Autonomous                     |                   |                                                                               |
| Email draft (compose for review)         | Autonomous                     |                   | Drafts visible in Daily Drafts Digest                                         |
| Email send — internal team               | Autonomous after 30-day shadow |                   | Draft-for-review for first 60 days                                            |
| Email send — external client             | Draft-for-review               |                   | Autonomous only after Day-90 + zero substantive errors over preceding 30 days |
| Status report assembly                   | Draft-for-review               |                   | Autonomous after 60 days of zero corrections required                         |
| Invoice generation                       | Autonomous                     |                   |                                                                               |
| Invoice send to client                   | Draft-for-review               |                   | Autonomous after Day-90                                                       |
| AR reminder (overdue notice)             | Draft-for-review               |                   | Autonomous up to threshold of $5,000; over that, always draft                 |
| Asset collection follow-up to client     | Autonomous                     |                   | Draft-for-review for first 30 days                                            |
| Brand-voice publication (social, blog)   | Draft-for-review               |                   | Not eligible for autonomous escalation in Phase 1                             |
| Paid-media campaign changes              | Draft-for-review               |                   | Not eligible for autonomous escalation in Phase 1                             |
| Retainer-hours reconciliation report     | Autonomous                     |                   |                                                                               |
| Scope-creep flag (surfaced internally)   | Autonomous                     |                   | Notifies champion in dashboard                                                |
| Proposal draft from discovery transcript | Draft-for-review               |                   | Customer must accept first 5 drafts before any autonomy escalation            |
| CRM read                                 | Autonomous                     |                   |                                                                               |
| CRM write — new contact, log activity    | Autonomous after 14-day shadow |                   |                                                                               |
| CRM write — stage change, deal value     | Draft-for-review               |                   |                                                                               |
| CRM destructive (delete, merge)          | Refused                        |                   | Never autonomous regardless of any override                                   |
| Financial decisions or commitments       | Refused                        |                   | Never autonomous                                                              |
| Legal authority statements               | Refused                        |                   | Never autonomous                                                              |
| Compliance certifications                | Refused                        |                   | Never autonomous                                                              |

**Customer-specific never-send list:** Any client engagement currently in dispute (Customer marks via portal). Any communication channel Customer designates as out-of-scope.

# Exhibit B — Marketing Agencies Skill Pack v1

The agent ships with the following skills configured to Customer's specific tool stack:

1. **Inbox Triager** — Reads incoming email, classifies (client / vendor / cold pitch / internal / spam), suggests labels, drafts replies for routine categories.
2. **Asset Collection Follower** — Generates daily "still missing X from client Y" list and follows up at 48h/96h/7d intervals on the customer's new-client checklist.
3. **Client Status Report Assembler** — Pulls from Customer's PM tool, GA4, and paid-media platforms; drafts the weekly client status email.
4. **Retainer Hours Reconciler** — Reads time tracker, maps to SOW line items, drafts weekly variance report (clients over/under contracted hours).
5. **AR Chaser** — Drafts reminder emails on aging invoices; sends per the autonomy settings in Exhibit A.
6. **Paid-Media Anomaly Watcher** — Daily check of Meta, Google, and LinkedIn ads for CPL spikes, disapprovals, frequency caps; drafts the daily anomaly digest.
7. **Scope-Creep Flagger** — Watches designated client Slack channels and project conversations; flags requests that don't map to current SOW.
8. **Proposal Drafter** — Reads discovery-call transcripts uploaded by Customer; drafts proposals against Customer's authored pricing matrix and SOW template.

Each skill respects the Trust Ceiling Matrix in Exhibit A.

Additional skills outside this pack may be added during the engagement as a scope expansion at $200/hr.

# Exhibit C — Service Levels and Incident Classes

SMD operates 8a–6p Mountain Standard Time, Monday–Friday. SLA clocks run during business hours only.

| Class  | Definition                                                                                                                                                                             | Acknowledge      | Initial remediation | Communication                                     |
| ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| **S1** | Agent took an action it shouldn't have. Customer-facing damage (a real client received a wrong or inappropriate message, a record was corrupted, a payment was triggered incorrectly). | 4 business hours | 24 business hours   | Phone call to champion immediately upon detection |
| **S2** | Agent is degraded but contained. Skill misclassifying, error rate spiked, drafts trending wrong but nothing sent externally. Service still up.                                         | 1 business day   | 3 business days     | Email and Slack to champion                       |
| **S3** | Cosmetic or minor. Dashboard graphic broken, one stuck job, a typo in a draft.                                                                                                         | 2 business days  | 5 business days     | Logged in dashboard; mentioned in weekly snapshot |

**Excluded from SLA:**

- Customer-side outages (Customer's Gmail down, Customer's CRM down)
- Third-party API outages (Anthropic, Cloudflare, Fly.io, Composio, AgentMail)
- Customer's own configuration changes that break the agent
- Force majeure

SMD will coordinate a best-effort response during such events but the SLA clock does not run.

**Root cause documentation:** Every S1 and S2 incident generates a written postmortem provided to Customer within 5 business days, including timeline, root cause, fix applied, and any process changes.
